title: hsm-keystore-sync-operator-add-rotation-plan-and-sealedsecret-migration
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Adds an idempotent HSM Keystore Sync Operator plus Helm and Terraform changes to automate certificate and keystore rotation for private deployments. Motivation: manual keystore rotation across on-prem HSMs and cloud KMS boundaries has been a high-friction operational task that caused outages during upgrades and prevented safe automated rollouts. This PR implements: 1) a lightweight operator (hsm-keystore-sync) that watches configured HSM instances and Vault/Transit endpoints, reconciles keystore/JKS/PKCS12 artifacts into a namespace-safe secret, and annotates resources with rotation metadata; 2) Helm pre-upgrade/post-upgrade hooks that perform staged keystore swaps and validate TLS handshake before switching live listeners; 3) a sealedsecret-to-vault-migration tool that converts selected SealedSecrets into Vault-backed secrets using an adoption plan and write-lock to avoid races; 4) Terraform module outputs and state migration helpers to surface keystore_version and last_rotated timestamps so Dedicated customers can integrate with external rotation policies; 5) comprehensive integration tests and a chaos test that simulates HSM failover and verifies graceful fallback to a cached KEK. This change is designed to be rollback-safe: keystore swaps are implemented as two-phase commits with ability to revert to previous secret if validation fails. Upgrade notes and operator config examples are in the README and chart values. The description includes a checklist, test plan, and rollout/rollback steps.
release_notes: Private-installer: add hsm-keystore-sync operator to automate HSM/JKS/PKCS12 rotation; Helm hooks for safe pre-upgrade keystore swaps; sealedsecret->vault migration helper; terraform outputs to expose keystore_version and last_rotated. No breaking changes; opt-in via chart values.
commits: feat(operator): initial hsm-keystore-sync controller and CRD with reconcile loop
chore(helm): add pre-upgrade/post-upgrade hook jobs and validation containers
feat(migration): sealedsecret-to-vault migration helper and adoption locking
feat(terraform): expose keystore_version/last_rotated outputs and state import helper
test(integration): add daily integration test exercising HSM failover path
docs: examples and upgrade notes for on-prem and multi-az deployments
review_comments: Marco Alvarez: Operator looks good but we need a clear audit trail for each rotation event. Please add an event and metric (keystore.rotation.count) - addressed in second commit.

Liu Chen: How do we ensure the operator does not leak private key material into logs or metrics? Author: encrypted-bytes are never logged and metrics are counts only; added e2e that verifies none of the pods contain PEM in plain-text - see tests/integration

Aisha Mbaye: Terraform output change may require state import docs for on-prem customers. Author: added terraform/modules/kms-keystore/README.md with import steps and an automated import helper script.

Marco Alvarez: Please add a canary rollout plan to the chart values so enterprise customers can opt into staged rotation. Author: added values.keystore.canaryPercentage and documented steps in README-keystore-operator.md.
notes_for_ops: Operator is opt-in via chart value values.keystore.enabled=true. Default behavior is no-op until a Keystore CR is created. Rollout plan: 1) enable operator in staging; 2) create Keystore CR with dryRun=true to validate swap; 3) run pre-upgrade hook job to stage keystore; 4) flip live listener after TLS validation passes; 5) monitor metric keystore.rotation.count and events for audit. Rollback: chart values.keystore.rollbackVersion set to previous version triggers two-phase revert. For Terraform, run terraform import module.kms_keystore.<name> before applying new outputs. For sealedsecret migration, use tools/sealedsecret-migrate with --dry-run then --apply once validated.
notes_for_devs: Design notes: operator uses the HSM plugin interface and Vault Transit to fetch wrapped keys; it stores only encrypted keystore blobs in Kubernetes secrets and annotates with keystore.v1.redwood.com/last-rotated. The controller includes leader election and a reconciliation window to avoid thundering herd. Tests added for idempotency and HSM connection drops.
changelog_excerpt: Added hsm-keystore-sync operator; helm hooks for safe keystore rotation; sealedsecret->vault migration helper; terraform outputs for keystore visibility.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for controller logic and migration tool; integration e2e simulates HSM primary failover and verifies TLS handshakes succeed with swapped keystore; CI runs include a simulated low-latency network partition test.
support_notes: If customers report TLS handshake failures after upgrade, verify operator logs (level=info) and events on the Keystore CR, then run the validation job included in the chart. For HSM keywrap mismatches, ensure KEK version in Vault matches the HSM-attested KEK and run the migration helper.
user_migration_instructions: 1) Set values.keystore.enabled=true in your private-installer chart and set values.keystore.canaryPercentage=10 for initial rollout; 2) Create a Keystore CR with reference to your HSM and transit path; 3) Run helm upgrade with --wait to execute the pre-upgrade hook; 4) Validate TLS endpoints with the provided validation container; 5) For sealedsecrets migration, run tools/sealedsecret-migrate --namespace <ns> --selector app=my-app --dry-run then --apply once review passes.
